# EIA-861 annual electric power industry report: reliability and service territory (GA, FL)

- Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861, https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia861/ (2024 from zip/f8612024.zip; 2013-2023 from archive/zip/f861YYYY.zip)
- Fetched: 2026-10-27
- Licence: U.S. Government work (EIA), public domain. Attribution: Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861.
- eia861_reliability_ga_fl.parquet: Reliability_States sheet 2013-2024, GA and FL utilities; IEEE SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI with and without major event days (MED), plus loss-of-supply-removed, customers. "." in the source is null. Annual, per utility: no per-storm timeline.
- eia861_service_territory_ga_fl.parquet: utility to county, 2015-2024 (2013-2014 zips have no Service_Territory file).
